item.description:

Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Athens tech · Meetup

AI can help us build dashboards faster than ever before. But faster does not automatically mean better. In this session, Marjolein Opsteegh shares practical examples of how she works together with AI while designing Power BI dashboards. You'll see where AI can save time, generate ideas, and challenge your thinking, but also where human judgment remains essential. The focus is not on writing DAX or creating visuals more quickly. It is about building dashboards that people can actually understand, interpret, and use to make decisions.
